reviewNotes: Haley's complete seven-line schedule dialogue asset is translated directly from English. Her clinic visit, home routine and winter outing retain their context, with all dialogue controls exact.

winter_9.000.source: It's nothing serious... I'm just here for my annual check-up.
winter_9.000.translation: Nu este nimic grav... Sunt aici doar pentru controlul anual.

winter_9.001.source: Well... my nose has been a little runny, Doctor. But otherwise I'm doing fine!
winter_9.001.translation: Ei bine... mi-a curs puțin nasul, domnule doctor. Dar în rest mă simt bine!

winter.000.source: It's too cold to get out of bed.
winter.000.translation: Este prea frig ca să mă dau jos din pat.

marriage_Mon.000.source: Hi, honey! I'm mostly just here to visit Emily.
marriage_Mon.000.translation: Bună, iubire! Am venit mai ales ca să o vizitez pe Emily.

rain.000.source: The weather's too horrible to get out of bed.
rain.000.translation: Vremea este prea groaznică ca să mă dau jos din pat.

winter_16.001.source: The cold air isn't so bad if you bundle up!$h
winter_16.001.translation: Aerul rece nu este atât de rău dacă te îmbraci gros!$h
